verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Dagster loading to Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres or object storage, nor swapping destinations without changing pipeline code. The Airbyte, Fivetran and dlt integrations orchestrate third-party loaders rather than showing destination portability. The team member's remark about separating business logic from environmental concerns is only adjacent and does not name any warehouse.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I load to the major warehouses and lakes — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, object storage — without changing pipelines
